description: Pure enrichment module for domain_trust signal (currently only 12 distinct values - weak discrimination per signal quality diagnostic). Exposes compute_score(metadata: dict) returning (float 0-100, evidence dict). Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields: registry_source, age_days, publisher_verified, stars, download_count, dependency_count to improve discrimination. Pure function: no DB writes, network, or imports of protected modules. Must yield at least 20 distinct scores across synthetic fingerprints per enricher contract. Evidence dict required for audit.
